_comment: Gates whose failure is KNOWN, JUSTIFIED and deliberately carried past the
push guard. This is not a way to push green CI -- CI still runs every gate
and still fails on anything listed here. It only lets the push HAPPEN, with
the failure named on the record instead of routed around silently.
block-unverified-push.sh enforces three things, and the last two are what
stop this becoming a permanent allowlist:
1. every FAILING gate must appear here, or the push is still refused;
2. every gate here must actually be failing -- a stale entry REFUSES,
so an excuse cannot outlive the failure it excuses;
3. the reason must be substantive, the same bar .dead-bash-allowlist
applies and gate-test:dead-bash proves with a low-effort-BLOCKER case.
A narrowed run (--only/--skip) is refused before any of this is consulted,
so carrying cannot become a second way to launder a partial lane.
